mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over the past 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) and retail sales (proxied by RSAFS) both decline by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 5% y-o-y
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 5% y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) rises above 60, indicating a rapid expansion in manufacturing activity, and the unemployment rate (proxied by UNRATE) is below 4%, signaling a tight labor market, it portends an overheating economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 60 and UNRATE < 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 2% and the consumer price index (proxied by CPIAUCSL) is rising by more than 3% year-over-year, it signals a high-inflation, low-rate environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL rising > 3% y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (proxied by UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (proxied by PAYEMS) is growing by more than 200,000 jobs per month, it signals a strong labor market that will support consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growing > 200k per month
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growing > 200k per month but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.
